pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost because the trend was the tell. Strange's 95, 68, 44 slide finished under 41.5 when JAX led big and threw about 20 times, with Boerkircher taking the one red-zone look, and the middle gap (8.95 versus 7.2 on the outside) was too small to bounce him. Tuten repeated the 39-yard rush game, Rodriguez took the fourth-quarter clock work after a 55-yard cameo in the prior log, the 48-yard receiving spike did not repeat, and a late bench with JAX up 17 left the combo in the mid-70s. The -117.5 price was the market telling us the 4-for-4 run was already priced.
